name: web-agency
description: A bespoke, human-crafted website engineered for **Lenora Developers**, an independent design and development studio. Designed with an **organic warm beige/linen canvas (`#f7f4ee`)**, **solid high-contrast typography (zero gradients)**, **subtle frosted glassmorphism**, **native scroll triggers**, **100% laptop and mobile responsiveness**, a **contact section with direct email and Instagram app navigation and Global Remote Working location**, and a **completely hidden Admin Portal** powered by **Supabase & Firebase**.
